newsitem.title: FRANCE: Romance still alive for French women - poll.
newsitem.headline: Romance still alive for French women - poll.

text.p: Romance is still alive for French women, who fall for men who shower them with gifts. But French men favour a partner who carries a condom in her bag.

An opinion poll released on Tuesday by the BVA institute for the weekly magazine Paris Match showed that 63 percent of women would favour a "reserved man who prefers to listen" over a muscular surfer-type or a know-it-all intellectual.
And in a blow for the fashion and cosmetics industries, 77 percent of men preferred a natural-looking woman to one dressed either in chic clothes or sporting a mini-skirt and high heels.

To be seduced, 49 percent of women preferred the passionate lover who sent flowers and bombarded her with telephone calls, while 27 percent would fall for a man who played the role of the dark and tormented soul.

Fifty-two percent of men, in bed with a woman for the first time, liked the idea of her being prepared and pulling a condom out of her handbag. Just 27 percent preferred her to be passionate and declaring her love in the heat of the moment.
Ten percent favoured the other option, that she was "imaginative and asks you to tie her to the bed". The poll, of 524 women and 524 men, was taken on April 11 and 12.
